Under ``'weighted_majority'`` (:data:`WEIGHTED_CLASSES`) the top barcode is the one with the most weight, and five columns are added. ``weight_top`` and ``weight_total`` are the summed read weights of the top barcode and of the cell. ``d_weight_top`` is the summed distance term of the top barcode's reads, and ``g_median_top`` their median nucleus distance (NaN without one). ``bleed_discounted`` counts the barcodes the neighbour discount weighed down.

Com ``minority_min_reads`` 2 ou mais, ``barcodes``, ``second_reads`` e a classe contam apenas as leituras que a regra mantém, e duas colunas são acrescentadas: ``minority_ignored`` (leituras deixadas de fora) e ``minority_rescued`` (True quando a célula é chamada apenas por causa da regra).
